finish.quote: Finish: long, dry peat, sweet oak, sea salt
finish.value: Long, warm, smoky with dry peat and brine

nose.quote: Nose: very thick peat smoke, iodine, sweet spices
nose.value: Coastal peat smoke, iodine, sweet spices, sherry

palate.quote: Palate: sweet, rich peat, sherry sweetness, salt
